description: This file contains Metal shader kernels and related functions for performing bitwise operations (and, or, xor, shift) on tensors in the context of Apple's Metal Performance Shaders (MPS) backend for PyTorch. It includes kernel definitions, utility functions for handling types and pipeline states, and dispatch functions for executing the kernels on the GPU.

methods.name: getMetalType
methods.description: Determines the Metal shader type string based on the C++ scalar type or tensor's scalar type.

methods.name: getCPLState
methods.description: Retrieves the compute pipeline state for a given set of tensors and function name.

methods.name: handle_binary_op
methods.description: Handles the execution of binary operations (and, or, xor, shifts) on tensors using MPS, managing output tensor preparation and invoking the GPU kernels.

methods.name: _bitwise_op_out_mps
methods.description: Performs the selected bitwise operation in MPS, managing scalar and tensor inputs, expanding tensors as needed, and copying results back.

methods.name: lshift_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel wrapper for left shift operation using MPS.

methods.name: rshift_kernel_mps
methods.description: Kernel wrapper for right shift operation using MPS.
